nodes.description: Mapping of user balances updated by _transfer and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner-to-spender allowances written by _approve.
Fixed total supply of the token (1000*10**12*10**18).
Owner address maintained by Ownable, read by _approve and written by ownership functions.
Address initialized to _msgSender() and used inside the onlyOwner modifier for the ownership check.
Token decimals value returned by decimals().
External ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Internal core transfer routine that debits and credits _balances and emits Transfer.
External approve that delegates allowance writing to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Internal allowance writer whose behavior depends on comparison with owner().
External transferFrom that performs _transfer and then reduces the spender allowance via _approve.
Read-only allowance getter over _allowances.
Read-only balance getter over _balances.
Read-only getter returning _tTotal.
Constructor that mints the entire supply to the deployer (msg.sender).
Restricted function that zeroes _owner under the onlyOwner modifier.
Restricted function that reassigns _owner under the onlyOwner modifier.
Modifier gate comparing newComer with _msgSender() to protect privileged functions.
Caller-controlled address used in transfer, approve, transferFrom, constructor and the ownership gate.
Balance arithmetic (sub/add) executed on _balances during transfers.
Sender address parameter of _transfer/transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer/transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter fed into balance arithmetic and allowance updates.
Spender address parameter of approve/_approve.
Local address variable in transferOwnership holding the new owner candidate.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of transfer().
transfer() calls the internal _transfer routine.
msg.sender is used as spender/recipient context in transferFrom().
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before updating allowances.
transferFrom() invokes _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
transferFrom() reads and rewrites _allowances for the caller.
msg.sender is passed as owner into _approve() from approve().
approve() delegates to the internal _approve writer.
_approve writes _allowances, zeroing amounts for non-owner callers.
_approve branches on comparison of the owner argument with owner().
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_transfer performs sub/add arithmetic on balances.
User-supplied amount is fed into balance arithmetic.
sender parameter drives the balance debit in _transfer.
recipient parameter drives the balance credit in _transfer.
amount parameter is applied to the balances in _transfer.
spender parameter is forwarded by approve() to _approve().
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve().
onlyOwner reads newComer for the authorization check.
onlyOwner compares newComer against the caller-controlled _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
newOwner local is validated and stored into _owner.
constructor mints the supply to msg.sender.
constructor initializes the deployer balance in _balances.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply returns the _tTotal state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to drive balance mutation inside _transfer, so it collapses into that core function.
The recipient parameter only exists to drive balance mutation inside _transfer, so it collapses into that core function.
The amount parameter is a direct argument of _transfer and feeds its balance arithmetic, so it merges into the function.
The spender parameter indexes _allowances solely inside _approve, so it merges into that core function.
newOwner is a temporary holder validated and stored by transferOwnership, so it merges into that function.
